program_descriptions.bed: A private sleeping room. Present in 91% of layouts (0-3 per layout).
program_descriptions.bath: A full bathroom with shower or tub. Present in 100% of layouts (1-2 per layout).
program_descriptions.living: A shared living area, often open-plan with kitchen. Present in 100% of layouts.
program_descriptions.circulation: Hallway, corridor, or entry area connecting rooms. Present in 96% of layouts.
program_descriptions.storage: A storage or utility room. Present in 75% of layouts.
program_descriptions.walkincloset: A walk-in closet or dressing room. Rare, present in 1% of layouts.
program_descriptions.wc: A small toilet room (half-bath) without shower or tub. Present in 59% of layouts.
